arm64_adaptations: Initialize the TCP socket lazily because CCF_JUST_LOAD skips the stock top-level initializer.
Parse numeric IPv4 dotted-quad text locally because the stock runtime parser depends on an unavailable compiler lexer helper.
Use a byte receive buffer with an explicit trailing NUL before passing received data to DocPrint as a string.
scope_note: This verifies one client connection, greeting, one user-entered message and echoed response, and normal Shift+Escape cleanup in QEMU user networking. It does not verify UTM networking, arbitrary external interfaces, multiple simultaneous clients, or reconnection after server loss.
